meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Karpathy 模式在 NanoClaw 群组中搭建可持续维护的 wiki:创建目录与初始文件,写入维护说明,并在处理来源时逐个消化、更新页面。
howto.when: 当你说出「add wiki」「wiki」「knowledge base」等关键词,意图为群组添加 wiki 知识库时触发。

say.text: 我们建一个 knowledge base 吧
say.note: 触发技能,进行设计讨论

say.text: 用 Karpathy wiki 模式给主群建知识库
say.note: 按模式创建目录与说明

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude sets up a persistent wiki for a NanoClaw group following Karpathy's pattern: creates wiki/ and sources/ dirs, initial files, a container skill, and a CLAUDE.md maintenance section. It processes sources one by one, updating wiki pages per file.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'add wiki', 'wiki', or 'knowledge base' when the user wants a wiki knowledge base added to a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki to this group

say_en.note: Triggers the skill and design discussion

say_en.text: Set up a Karpathy wiki for the main group
